original.name: Soft Signal
original.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: distinct standalone mascot illustration for a workplace chat application named Lazy. Primary request: an original full-body sloth character called Moss, communicating relaxed competence and warmth, awake, friendly small smile, gently holding a tiny unlettered coral speech-bubble-shaped object. Original visual identity: broad pear-shaped moss-green body, cream oval face with deep forest bean-shaped eye patches, long curved arms, three simple cream claws per hand. Tiny peach cheek dots. No clothes. Style/medium: sophisticated handmade cut-paper illustration, layered organic shapes, subtle paper fibers, clean restrained silhouette, dimensionality only from paper layering, adult editorial brand not children's cartoon. Color palette: forest #183F35, sage #A9C3A0, pale cream #F5F1E7, peach #E9A38D. Composition: one isolated character centered, full body and both arms visible, ample even transparent margins, square canvas. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no floor, no backdrop, no text, no letters, no extra characters, no watermark. This is a character artwork, not a logo or layout.
original.heroPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: website hero illustration. A beautiful panoramic brand illustration for Lazy workplace chat, direction Soft Signal. Reference image: the sloth mascot design and paper texture ONLY; this is a new scene, not an edit of the cutout. Create an imaginary quiet grove built of huge rounded cream and sage speech-bubble-shaped leaves, a thin forest green curved branch forming a hammock-like arc, small coral conversation bubbles drifting between the leaves. Include the same recognizably designed small green sloth from the reference sitting awake on the curved branch, occupying about one quarter of the composition. All parts form a harmonious communal canopy motif that represents easy human conversation. Layered cut-paper art, tactile subtle fibers, sophisticated graphic illustration, large flowing shapes and generous visual breathing room. Palette forest #183F35, sage #A9C3A0, cream #F5F1E7, peach #E9A38D. Wide landscape 3:2 composition, cream full bleed background, image fills canvas, no text, no letters, no logo, no interface, no typography, no watermark. Not photorealistic.
